highlights: ECHR (Grand Chamber, 25 Aug 2026): orders Türkiye to release Osman Kavala immediately and declares his conviction null and void (Kavala v. Türkiye no. 2) — several Convention violations under Article 46.
UN CERD Early Warning Procedure (28 Aug 2026): warns Tanzania to halt forced evictions of Maasai from Ngorongoro/Loliondo and address law-enforcement abuses.
ECHR Grand Chamber (7 Jul 2026): Italy violated the right to respect for the home — Mafia-inquiry search seized data of 6,000+ individuals without safeguards (Grande Oriente d'Italia v. Italy).
ECHR Grand Chamber (9 Jul 2026): no violation of ne bis in idem; clarified double-jeopardy limits in parallel proceedings (Jesus Pinhal v. Portugal).
actions_taken: opened PR (no merge — human review only)
